correct_completion: I still take it every day.
full_sentence: Although the bus is slow, I still take it every day.
acceptable_variants: I still ride it to work.
I keep taking it to school.

options.text: so I walk to school every day.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' shows contrast, not cause. 'So' shows a result, so this option does not fit the sentence.

options.text: the bus stop is near my house.
options.why_wrong: This gives extra information, but it does not contrast with the slow bus.

options.text: I still take it every day.
it is a very big bus.
options.why_wrong: This describes the bus again, but it does not complete the contrast started by 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', we need a clause that shows contrast with the first part of the sentence. Here the bus is slow, but the speaker still continues to use it.
translation: Aunque el autobús es lento, todavía lo tomo todos los días.
